hook: What if your city only got 0.76 mm of rain each year?

sections.voiceover: What if your city only got 0.76 mm of rain each year?

Guinness World Records confirmed Arica averages only 0.76 mm of rain yearly from airport data. It recorded a 172‑month dry spell—from October 1903 to January 1918—with zero rain. How does such aridity shape life in Arica?
Yet the city still draws tourists despite the relentless drought.
The Atacama Desert spans 1,000 km of coast and gets 10–15 mm of rain yearly. Locals harvest fog water while tourists come for the desert experience.
Arica still thrives with just 0.76 mm of rain.
